title: Mean of a biased bit
statement: Let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $b$ be a Boolean random variable that equals true with probability $p$ and false with probability $1-p$. Assign value $1$ to true and $0$ to false. The mean of this value is $p$.
hypotheses_covered: The bit has the $p$-biased probability mass function
